# Output reference

<!-- Generated by scripts/generate_outputs_doc.py from src/alien/schema.py; do not edit by hand. -->

Output schema version: **2** (recorded in `MANIFEST.json` and `metadata/source_provenance.json`). It is bumped whenever a file or column changes incompatibly.

Every build is written to a hidden staging directory beside `project.outdir`, pruned to the output mode, given a `MANIFEST.json`, and swapped into place atomically. A failed build leaves the previous output untouched and keeps its diagnostics under `<outdir>/failed/`. Tables are tab-separated; `.tsv.gz` files are gzip-compressed with a zero timestamp so identical builds give identical bytes.

| File | Modes | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `gmt/<namespace>.gmt` | full, minimal, gmt | One GMT per namespace (symbols plus each target). Terms sorted by ID; genes sorted; empty terms omitted. |
| `MANIFEST.json` | full, minimal, gmt | Every file in the build with sha256 and size, the ALIEN version, output schema version and mode. Written last; `alien verify` re-hashes against it. |
| `metadata/effective_config.yml` | full, minimal | The validated configuration used, without project.outdir. |
| `metadata/source_provenance.json` | full, minimal | ALIEN version, packages, platform, config sha256, every input file and remote resource with hashes, redundancy settings, worker count and warnings. The only file with a timestamp. |
| `metadata/source_manifest.tsv` | full, minimal | One row per loaded source collection. |
| `metadata/term_manifest.tsv.gz` | full, minimal | One row per (term, namespace) with the namespace-specific outcome. |
| `metadata/target_metadata_fallbacks.tsv` | full, minimal | What each annotation metadata fallback added. |
| `metadata/target_output_genes.tsv.gz` | full, minimal | Configured output_genes per target. |
| `metadata/target_gene_filter.tsv.gz` | full, minimal | Configured gene_filter IDs per target. |
| `metadata/gene_mapping_<target>.tsv.gz` | full | The annotation helper used for one target (GTF, fallbacks and output-gene symbol rows). |
| `metadata/gene_symbol_master.tsv.gz` | full | The HGNC complete set used for symbol resolution. |
| `metadata/removed_terms_size_filter.tsv.gz` | full | Terms removed by size or broad-term filters. |
| `metadata/removed_terms_redundancy.tsv.gz` | full | Terms removed as exact or Jaccard duplicates. |
| `metadata/unmapped_genes.tsv.gz` | full | Memberships that could not be mapped. |
| `metadata/dropped_non_gene_tokens.tsv.gz` | full | Memberships dropped as configured non-gene tokens. |
| `metadata/ambiguous_gene_mappings.tsv.gz` | full | Memberships dropped because a symbol matched several genes. |
| `metadata/ensembl_archive_audit.tsv.gz` | full | Every source Ensembl ID checked against the Ensembl archive and its outcome. |
| `metadata/ncbi_gene_rescue_audit.tsv.gz` | full | Every NCBI Gene rescue attempt and its outcome. |
| `metadata/term_id_collisions.tsv` | full | Only when two sources produce the same term_id with different identities. |
| `qc/collection_summary.tsv` | full | Term counts and sizes after each filter stage. |
| `qc/collection_summary.json` | full | The same table as JSON records. |
| `qc/mapping_summary.tsv` | full, minimal | Mapping counts and rates per namespace, family and source. |
| `qc/mapping_status_summary.tsv` | full | Membership counts per mapping status. |
| `qc/redundancy_summary.tsv` | full, minimal | Term counts through exact and Jaccard redundancy removal. |
| `qc/target_namespace_summary.tsv` | full, minimal | Target ID-set sizes and annotation coverage. |
| `qc/ensembl_archive_summary.tsv` | full | Archive audit counts by status. |
| `qc/non_gene_token_summary.tsv` | full | Dropped non-gene tokens by source. |
| `qc/ncbi_gene_rescue_summary.tsv` | full | NCBI rescue counts by stage and outcome. |
| `qc/warnings.txt` | full, minimal | Build warnings, one per line. |

## Columns

`source`, `source_tag`, `collection`, `subcollection`, `family`, `aspect`, `db_version`, `selected_library`, `configured_name`, `match`, `match_method`, `candidate_libraries`, `n_terms`, `n_memberships`, `n_unique_symbols`, `source_url`, `source_license_note`

## Canonical membership table

Every source is normalized to these columns before mapping (one row per term and gene):

`term_id`, `original_name`, `display_name`, `description`, `source`, `source_tag`, `collection`, `subcollection`, `family`, `aspect`, `db_version`, `source_url`, `source_license_note`, `gene_symbol`, `gene_ensembl_from_source`, `metadata_json`
